findings.title: Group divider reinsert loses focus and pointer capture on its own resize publication

counterexample.publicRoute: Project actions > Second Canvas; interact with Resize canvas-1 and canvas-2
counterexample.keyboard: Click separator; ArrowDown moves value to416.50000000000006, then native focus is BODY. A second ArrowDown leaves value unchanged. Escape leaves weights1.0195838433292534 /0.9804161566707466 instead of original1/1.
counterexample.pointer: Drag the same separator70px with real Playwright mouse down/move/up: final weights remain1/1; expected changed weights.

findings.cause: syncPairs calls root.before(existingDivider) during every workspace publication, even when the divider is already correctly placed. Removing/reinserting the focused/captured node causes blur/lostpointercapture and defeats the shared divider gesture.
contract: handoff/compatibility/behavior-contracts.md LC-UI-062/B01: keyboard adjustment, Escape initial-value rollback, group weights
findings.expectedBehavior: Keep a correctly placed divider DOM node in place during value-only publication. Continuous pointer resize, repeated keyboard steps and Escape rollback must work without losing native focus/capture.
findings.requiredRepairEvidence: Trusted repeated Arrow/Shift/Home/End/Escape and drag/rollback on adjacent group dividers, plus actual pane reorder and natural Node Escape. Preserve original failing traces.
findings.lineage: Same general DOM reinsert/focus mechanism as the implementer-retained pre-final counterexample, now independently observed on group-divider updates. No inherited review budget reset is authorized.

findings.title: Placeholder retry permits reentrant close and resurrects an orphan Panel

counterexample.setup: Use registered conforming reviewer Panel; initial restore throws, leaving placeholder P in pane main. Remove failure; install beforePanelDispose callback that calls workspace.close(P); invoke retry(P).
counterexample.actual: Reentrant close succeeds. retry subsequently writes its constructed replacement into records, but pane main has tabs[] and active:null. The live P record has no Tab; a later layout save would fail structural validation.

findings.cause: construct restores #publishing before retry emits #beforeDispose; this lifecycle notification is outside the workspace mutation guard. The replacement is then installed without checking that the old record/placement survived.
contract: handoff/04_EXTENSION_MODEL.md failures: Workspace own public API refuses notification reentry
Reviewer packet required independent reentrant lifecycle and same-ID retry probes
findings.expectedBehavior: Lifecycle callbacks during retry must not mutate Workspace. Keep the old record/Tab intact until the guarded replacement transition, and preserve structural consistency under callback errors.
findings.requiredRepairEvidence: Independent retry callback close/move/dispose reentry tests, owned Context retry, same-ID incarnation, stale callback rejection, no partial tab/record loss.
findings.probeClassification: Reviewer-authored synchronous conformance injection through public lifecycle API; not a physical-input or arbitrary-external-Panel qualification claim.

findings.title: Valid null private state is silently replaced with the original saved state
affectedScope: B01 complete current-layout private state export

counterexample.setup: Registered reviewer Panel restores {remember:original}; later its exportViewState returns the valid finite JSON value null. Call Workspace.save().
counterexample.actual: Saved panel.state is {remember:original}, not null. No error is reported.

findings.cause: Nullish-coalescing fallback treats a live Panel export of null as if no live instance exists.
contract: handoff/04_EXTENSION_MODEL.md private finite JSON state and complete save/failure behavior
findings.expectedBehavior: Choose fallback based on instance absence, while preserving every valid JSON export including null. Invalid or throwing live export must refuse save.
findings.requiredRepairEvidence: Roundtrip null private state and retain opaque placeholder fallback; whole-save export-failure refusal remains intact.
